value.rationale: The complete first nontrivial state-complexity classification answers the bounded-versus-unbounded question for every at-most-two-state regular suffix rule, not an arbitrary single instance. It distinguishes bounded parity behavior from two different sharp unbounded growth regimes and gives an exact structural run-block formula useful for constructing and calibrating regular word-game Grundy algorithms.
